product_overview: A minimal, local-first e-commerce demo that lets visitors browse products, view details, and use a hardcoded test account to simulate purchases and manage products via an admin UI. All data and authentication are in-memory/mock for easy local demoing.
core_goals: Provide a browseable product catalog with detail pages
Support a fixed test-account login flow for demo purchases
Simulate purchase flow and maintain in-memory order history
Offer an admin UI to add/edit/delete products in local state
Keep everything local and easy to run without external services

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to sign in using the hardcoded demo credentials and redirect them to the product catalog on success.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email in the Email input -> Enter password in the Password input -> Click Login button -> Observe redirect to /
Navigate to /login -> Enter email in the Email input (wrong) -> Enter password in the Password input (wrong) -> Click Login button -> Observe Invalid credentials message

features.name: Browse Product Catalog
features.description: Display product cards from local/mock data and allow navigation to a product's detail view.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Wait for products to load -> Click View Details on a product card -> Navigate to /product/:id
Navigate to / -> Wait for products to load -> Observe empty state message when mock data contains no products

features.name: View Product Details
features.description: Show a single product's image, metadata, price and description based on the route parameter; show a not-found state for invalid ids.
user_flows: Navigate to /product/:id with a valid id -> Read product image -> Read product metadata -> Read product description and price
Navigate to /product/:id with an invalid id -> Observe not found state or message

features.name: Purchase Flow Simulation
features.description: Simulate a buy action: unauthenticated users are redirected to login; authenticated users receive success feedback via a snackbar.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click Buy on a product while logged out -> Observe redirect to /login -> Enter email in the Email input -> Enter password in the Password input -> Click Login button -> Return to catalog or product details -> Click Buy on the product -> Observe Purchase successful snackbar
Log in using test credentials -> Navigate to /product/:id -> Click Buy -> Observe Purchase successful snackbar

features.name: Order History Access
features.description: Allow authenticated users to view a list of their purchases; unauthenticated access redirects to login.
user_flows: Navigate to /orders while logged out -> Observe redirect to /login
Enter email in the Email input -> Enter password in the Password input -> Click Login button -> Navigate to /orders -> Wait for orders to load -> View order cards

features.name: Admin Product Management (UI Only)
features.description: A UI for adding, editing and deleting products stored in local component/state only, with snackbar confirmations; access is protected by the demo auth.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin while logged out -> Observe redirect to /login

Enter email in the Email input -> Enter password in the Password input -> Click Login button -> Navigate to /admin -> Fill product form fields -> Click Submit/Add button -> Observe snackbar confirmation for add
Navigate to /admin -> Click Edit on an existing product -> Update form fields -> Click Save/Submit -> Observe snackbar confirmation for update
Navigate to /admin -> Click Delete on an existing product -> Confirm deletion if prompted -> Observe snackbar confirmation for delete

known_limitations.issue: All data is mock/local and there is no backend persistence
known_limitations.impact: State resets on page reload and changes are not durable

known_limitations.issue: Authentication is in-memory only and uses hardcoded test credentials
known_limitations.impact: No real user accounts, sessions, or secure auth

known_limitations.issue: Buy action and admin CRUD are simulated with snackbar feedback only
known_limitations.impact: No real order creation or product updates in a backend
